Info

Manages filesystem dialogs and document persistence for the SCARA DSL script editor.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.dsl.dsl_document_manager.DslDocumentManager(*, storage: IPlanStorageService | None = None)[source]¶

Bases: object

Orchestrates modal file dialogs and script document persistence.

It defines:

attributes:
_storage - Plan storage service instance used for file I/O.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes the document manager with storage service.
open_document - Prompts file open dialog and loads script text.
save_document - Prompts file save dialog and writes script text to disk.
open_document(*, parent: Widget, initial_dir: str | None = None) → tuple[str, str] | None[source]¶

Presents modal file dialog to select a .scara file and loads its text content.

Parameters:

  • parent – Parent widget owning the modal dialog.

  • initial_dir – Optional starting filesystem directory path.

Returns:

Tuple of (content, filepath) if successfully loaded, or None if cancelled/failed.

Exceptions:

None.

save_document(*, parent: Widget, content: str) → str | None[source]¶

Presents modal file save dialog and saves script text content to disk.

Parameters:

  • parent – Parent widget owning the modal dialog.

  • content – DSL script text to write.

Returns:

Filepath where script was saved, or None if cancelled/failed.

Exceptions:

None.
